lines.zh: 我走过好几个维度，只带一只箱子。
lines.en: I have crossed many realms with a single case.

lines.zh: 脚步轻一点，货物就不会碰坏。
lines.en: Softer steps keep the merchandise from breaking.

lines.zh: 这条路我走过，那次没卖出一件。
lines.en: I have walked this road before and sold nothing then.

lines.zh: 我只在能找到买家的时候停下。
lines.en: I stop only where a buyer might be found.

lines.zh: 箱子比我还沉，但我从不请人抬。
lines.en: The case outweighs me, yet I never ask for help.

lines.zh: 从这片荒原到下一片，价钱一样。
lines.en: From one wasteland to the next, the prices hold.

lines.zh: 我不问路，路会自己接上。
lines.en: I ask no directions; the roads join themselves.

lines.zh: 走慢些，让想买的人看见我。
lines.en: Walk slower, so anyone buying can spot me.

lines.zh: 灰落在肩上，我不去拍。
lines.en: Ash settles on my shoulder, and I let it stay.

lines.zh: 我的鞋底磨薄了，货却一件没少。
lines.en: My soles wear thin, but not one item is gone.

lines.zh: 穿过传送门时，我先护住箱子。
lines.en: Crossing a portal, I shield the case first.

lines.zh: 前面有村子，也许有人缺一块晶石。
lines.en: A village ahead; someone may need a crystal.

lines.zh: 我不赶时间，时间才赶我。
lines.en: I do not rush time; time rushes me.

lines.zh: 每一步都算过，包括该走多远。
lines.en: I have reckoned every step, including how far.

lines.zh: 我把货物摆好，又摆了一遍。
lines.en: I arrange my goods, then arrange them again.

lines.zh: 没有人来，我就检查价格。
lines.en: When nobody comes, I check the prices.

lines.zh: 我的货单很长，字很小。
lines.en: My ledger is long and the writing is tiny.

lines.zh: 沉默是我的招牌，比吆喝管用。
lines.en: Silence is my sign, and it works better than shouting.

lines.zh: 箱子里少了一件，我记得是哪件。
lines.en: One item is missing from the case, and I know which.

lines.zh: 我数着时间，等货物自己回来。
lines.en: I count the hours and wait for stock to return.

lines.zh: 风把货单翻页，我按住它。
lines.en: The wind flips my ledger, and I hold the page down.

lines.zh: 五十点生命，够我活到下一单生意。
lines.en: Fifty points of life will last until the next sale.

lines.zh: 我坐在箱子上，箱子里全是技能。
lines.en: I sit on the case, and the case is full of skill.

lines.zh: 别人说话时，我在算利钱。
lines.en: While others talk, I calculate the margin.

lines.zh: 这块布擦晶石，比擦脸重要。
lines.en: This cloth polishes crystals, not my face.

lines.zh: 我没有家，箱子放下的地方就是店。
lines.en: I have no home; wherever I set the case, I trade.

lines.zh: 夜里我也不熄灯，怕错过客人。
lines.en: I keep the lamp lit at night for late customers.

lines.zh: 沉默久了，连自己都忘了声音。
lines.en: Silent so long, I have forgotten my own voice.

lines.zh: 你看了我三次，是在算钱吗？
lines.en: You looked at me three times; are you counting coins?

lines.zh: 我不说话，你看货单就好。
lines.en: I will not speak; read the ledger instead.

lines.zh: 你的背包很鼓，看来是好客人。
lines.en: Your pack is full, which marks you a good customer.

lines.zh: 我抬眼，是在估你的等级。
lines.en: I lift my eyes to estimate your level.

lines.zh: 别问我从哪来，问价吧。
lines.en: Do not ask where I am from; ask the price.

lines.zh: 你看我的眼神，和看货架一样。
lines.en: You look at me the way you look at shelves.

lines.zh: 我能看出你有没有带够。
lines.en: I can tell whether you brought enough.

lines.zh: 眼熟吗？我在别的维度也卖过。
lines.en: Do I look familiar? I sold in other realms too.

lines.zh: 你的手在抖，是想要还是怕？
lines.en: Your hands tremble; is that wanting or fear?

lines.zh: 我不认识你，但我认识你的钱。
lines.en: I do not know you, but I know your coin.

lines.zh: 看着我，别看我身后的箱子。
lines.en: Look at me, not at the case behind me.

lines.zh: 你的同伴在退后，他很懂行。
lines.en: Your companion steps back; he understands.

lines.zh: 我把价签转给你，自己看。
lines.en: I turn the price tag toward you; read it.

lines.zh: 你站得够久了，想买什么？
lines.en: You have stood long enough; what will you buy?

lines.zh: 我把货单往前推了推
lines.en: I nudge the list of wares forward.

lines.zh: 你看货，我看你手里的钱
lines.en: You look at the wares; I look at your coin.

lines.zh: 别打摊子，货比我还疼。
lines.en: Do not hit the stall; the goods hurt more than I do.

lines.zh: 这一下，我要记进损失。
lines.en: That one goes in the losses column.

lines.zh: 我流血了，价钱也会涨。
lines.en: I am bleeding, so the prices will rise.

lines.zh: 疼，但账不能断。
lines.en: It hurts, but the ledger must not stop.

lines.zh: 你打碎了我一只瓶子。
lines.en: You broke one of my bottles.

lines.zh: 我早说过，动手要赔。
lines.en: I told you violence comes with a bill.

lines.zh: 五十点生命，我数得很清楚。
lines.en: Fifty points of life, and I count them clearly.

lines.zh: 商用不着这样，我可以讲价。
lines.en: No need for violence; we can negotiate the price.

lines.zh: 我捂住箱子，不是捂伤口。
lines.en: I cover the case, not the wound.

lines.zh: 这一下算你欠我的。
lines.en: That one leaves you in my debt.

lines.zh: 你举着食物，我只收钱。
lines.en: You raise food at me; I take only coin.

lines.zh: 那东西我不吃，但我可以帮你卖。
lines.en: I will not eat that, but I can sell it for you.

lines.zh: 拿面包换晶石？不划算。
lines.en: Bread for a crystal? A poor trade.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，值三个铜板。
lines.en: What you hold is worth three copper pieces.

lines.zh: 别晃了，我只看重量和成色。
lines.en: Stop waving it; I judge weight and quality only.

lines.zh: 想用食物抵账？把账本拿来。
lines.en: Paying with food? Then bring the ledger.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我的胃和嘴一起沉默了。
lines.en: I am not hungry; my stomach keeps the same silence.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿我收，转手能翻倍。
lines.en: I will take that; it resells at double.

lines.zh: 你把它举那么高，是想我出价？
lines.en: Holding it that high, are you asking for a bid?

lines.zh: 便宜货我不碰，掉价。
lines.en: I do not touch cheap goods; they lower the tone.

lines.zh: 小心，箱子里装着我全部的货。
lines.en: Careful, the case holds my entire stock.

lines.zh: 撞到我不要紧，撞到箱子要赔。
lines.en: Bumping me is fine; bumping the case costs you.

lines.zh: 我退半步，不是怕，是护货。
lines.en: I step back not from fear, but to shield goods.

lines.zh: 你的肩碰到我的货架了。
lines.en: Your shoulder touched my display rack.

lines.zh: 别推，晶石会裂，裂了就打折。
lines.en: Do not push; crystals crack, and cracked ones discount.

lines.zh: 我们之间留一臂，是行规。
lines.en: One arm's length between us is trade custom.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的货单了，抬脚。
lines.en: You stepped on my ledger; lift your foot.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我要重新核价。
lines.en: One bump and I must recheck every price.

lines.zh: 我不还手，还手会碎东西。
lines.en: I do not hit back; hitting breaks merchandise.

lines.zh: 靠这么近，你是想偷看货单？
lines.en: So close, are you peeking at the ledger?

lines.zh: 我的伴侣是这本账，翻了很多年。
lines.en: My partner is this ledger, turned for many years.

lines.zh: 同行相遇，我们只交换价格。
lines.en: When colleagues meet, we exchange prices only.

lines.zh: 成家要停业，我不愿意。
lines.en: Starting a family means closing shop, and I decline.

lines.zh: 我这样的人，嫁娶都算成本。
lines.en: For someone like me, marriage counts as a cost.

lines.zh: 两个商人在一起，只会算账。
lines.en: Two merchants together would only do arithmetic.

lines.zh: 别替我张罗，我的货还没卖完。
lines.en: Do not arrange anything for me; my stock is unsold.

lines.zh: 我年轻时也有过，后来换成了箱子。
lines.en: I had someone once, then traded it for a case.

lines.zh: 感情不能补货，所以我少碰。
lines.en: Affection cannot be restocked, so I keep away.

lines.zh: 同行的妻子替他看摊，我没有摊子。
lines.en: A colleague's wife minds his stall; I have no stall.

lines.zh: 我走得太远，谁跟得上？
lines.en: I travel too far; who could keep up?

lines.zh: 地上那枚晶石，我出两个铜板。
lines.en: That crystal on the ground: I bid two copper.

lines.zh: 你掉的，我可以代你保管，收费。
lines.en: What you dropped, I can keep for you, for a fee.

lines.zh: 弯腰捡货，是商人的本能。
lines.en: Stooping for goods is a merchant's instinct.

lines.zh: 这枚箭头有锈，不值钱。
lines.en: This arrowhead is rusted and worth nothing.

lines.zh: 我捡起来看了看，又放回去了。
lines.en: I picked it up, examined it, and put it back.

lines.zh: 掉在我脚边的，都算我的库存。
lines.en: Whatever drops by my feet becomes inventory.

lines.zh: 我不白捡，我记账。
lines.en: I never take for free; I enter it in the book.

lines.zh: 那块布可以做包装，我收下。
lines.en: That cloth will do for wrapping, so I take it.

lines.zh: 你的东西我不碰，怕算不清。
lines.en: I leave your things alone; the accounting gets messy.

lines.zh: 弯腰太多次，箱子会倒。
lines.en: Bend too often and the case tips over.

lines.zh: 有人靠近，我先合上账本。
lines.en: Someone approaches, so I close the ledger first.

lines.zh: 看你的脚步，不是来买的。
lines.en: Your footsteps say you are not here to buy.

lines.zh: 我记住每个走近的人，不分敌友。
lines.en: I note everyone who comes near, friend or not.

lines.zh: 别紧张，我只做买卖。
lines.en: Do not be tense; I only trade.

lines.zh: 你手里的武器，我会算进风险。
lines.en: The weapon in your hand counts as risk.

lines.zh: 来了个活人，也许今天有生意。
lines.en: A living person arrives; perhaps there is business today.

lines.zh: 我退到箱子后面，先护住货。
lines.en: I move behind the case and guard the stock.

lines.zh: 这种眼神我见过，是来抢的。
lines.en: I know that look; it comes to rob.

lines.zh: 我认得你的装备，值不少钱。
lines.en: I recognize your gear; it is worth a fair sum.

lines.zh: 别动刀，动了就要赔。
lines.en: Do not draw steel; anything broken must be paid for.

lines.zh: 我一直看着你，直到你离开。
lines.en: I keep watching until you leave.

lines.zh: 你绕我的箱子转了两圈。
lines.en: You circled my case twice.

lines.zh: 我不追人，我只会涨价。
lines.en: I do not chase people; I raise prices.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就松开视线。
lines.en: Step back once and I release my gaze.

lines.zh: 我只看你袖口，那里藏着钱。
lines.en: I watch your cuff, where the money hides.

lines.zh: 这是我的摊子，规矩由我定。
lines.en: This is my stall, and its rules are mine.

lines.zh: 你数我的货，我也在数你的。
lines.en: You count my goods, and I count yours.

lines.zh: 再看下去，我会把价翻一倍。
lines.en: Keep staring and I double the price.

lines.zh: 你的同伴绕到后面了，我看见了。
lines.en: Your friend went around the back, and I saw.

lines.zh: 我不喊人，我自己就够。
lines.en: I will not call for help; I am enough.

lines.zh: 我用秤杆挡一下，仅此而已。
lines.en: I block with my scale rod, nothing more.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，但我记账了。
lines.en: That was light, but I have entered it.

lines.zh: 我打不过你，可我会报价。
lines.en: I cannot beat you, but I can quote a price.

lines.zh: 别逼我，五十点生命不多。
lines.en: Do not push me; fifty points of life is little.

lines.zh: 箱子砸过去，碎了也算你的。
lines.en: The case is thrown; if it breaks, you pay.

lines.zh: 我出手很笨，收钱很准。
lines.en: My strikes are clumsy, but my change is exact.

lines.zh: 退开，我不做赔本的打斗。
lines.en: Back off; I do not fight at a loss.

lines.zh: 这一杖是赠品，不必付钱。
lines.en: This blow is a free sample.

lines.zh: 我打你是为了结束对话。
lines.en: I strike you to end the conversation.

lines.zh: 伤了我，你就再也买不到了。
lines.en: Wound me and you will never buy here again.

lines.zh: 箱子落地，店就算开了。
lines.en: The case lands, and the shop is open.

lines.zh: 我从别的维度来，带着新货。
lines.en: I come from another realm with fresh stock.

lines.zh: 这里风大，得找块石头压住货单。
lines.en: Windy here; I need a stone to weight the ledger.

lines.zh: 又一个陌生的地方，先看买家在哪。
lines.en: Another strange place; first, where are the buyers?

lines.zh: 我落地时先数货，一件不少。
lines.en: On landing I count the goods, and all are here.

lines.zh: 灯点起来，就算开张。
lines.en: Light the lamp, and the stall is open.

lines.zh: 没人迎接商人，只有风。
lines.en: No one greets a merchant here but the wind.

lines.zh: 这块地没人要，正好摆摊。
lines.en: Nobody claims this ground; good for a stall.

lines.zh: 我摆好价签，等第一位客人。
lines.en: I set the tags and wait for the first customer.

lines.zh: 新的维度，旧的价目表。
lines.en: A new realm, an old price list.

lines.zh: 火苗碰到货单，我赶紧拍灭。
lines.en: A flame touched the ledger, and I slapped it out.

lines.zh: 箱子先落地，我垫在后面。
lines.en: The case lands first, and I cushion it.

lines.zh: 水进来之前，我先把账本举高。
lines.en: Before the water rises, I lift the ledger high.

lines.zh: 炸坏了三件，我全记你账上。
lines.en: Three items ruined, all billed to you.

lines.zh: 箭钉进箱子，幸好没穿到晶石。
lines.en: The arrow stuck in the case, not the crystal.

lines.zh: 魔法不许碰货，这是规矩。
lines.en: Magic does not touch the merchandise; that is a rule.

lines.zh: 饿着肚子也能算账，我试过。
lines.en: I can do sums hungry; I have practiced.

lines.zh: 雷劈坏了招牌，得重新写。
lines.en: Lightning ruined the sign, so I must rewrite it.

lines.zh: 虚空要收摊了，我得快走。
lines.en: The void is closing the stall, so I must go quickly.
